idea-plugin.name: ACP Agent Client
idea-plugin.description:
A generic Agent Client Protocol (ACP) client for a remote ACP agent reachable over a WebSocket.
  • Chat with the agent in the ACP Agent tool window: streamed replies, tool-call cards, Stop and New chat.
  • Every command and file operation the agent requests runs locally, in the open project: commands are local processes in the project root, file reads see unsaved editors, writes are undoable.
  • Allow / Always allow / Reject prompts for commands and edits.
  • Bearer token (kept in the IDE password safe) or OAuth 2.0 sign-in with the browser (PKCE).
